text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hm… Yeah, I can't shake this feeling. Is Fine Motion really okay?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I've got no idea what the use of worrying is. Let's just cheer her on. I'm sure our feelings will reach her.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Right…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whether they reach her or not, she's got her work cut out for her. What will you do, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, I can't sit still!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If I don't wow everyone today, how am I going to stay in their hearts?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It won't be good enough to just run as usual, right? Maybe I should try being more reckless… like running all over the place!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know. I would never actually do anything to besmirch the race!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But I just can't think of anything. What should I do…
choice_data_list: Just do what you've been doing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You're telling me to just enjoy the race like always?
choice_data_list: Just have as much fun as you can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just by enjoying herself, Fine Motion has captured the hearts of countless fans and inspired other Umamusume to dream big.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's already made a huge impact, so the only thing she really needs to change is her mindset—to something totally opposite of simply wishing for things to never end.
choice_data_list: Hope and wish that everyone always remembers you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that's an interesting way to look at it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Then perhaps I'll give it a try—with a prayer, that is.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Please… carve the image of me running into everyone's hearts!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: With the same intensity that a ramen chef carves chashu pork!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Like, HI-YAH!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Gyah! Uh, F-Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, did I startle you? I've just gotten so reenergized.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I've got a different flavor today. I hope you enjoy it, Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: …! I see!
